info.name: Skytrack Backend API
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for the Skytrack vehicle tracking & SOS emergency response system.

## Quick Start
1. Set `base_url`, `login_username`, `login_password` in collection variables.
2. The **collection-level pre-request script** auto-fetches a JWT via `POST /api/dev/token/` (DEBUG mode only) before the first request.
3. All authenticated requests automatically include `Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}`.

## Two-Stage Login (Production Flow)
```
1. POST /api/generate-captcha/  → get captcha_key + base64 image
2. POST /api/user_login/         → RSA-encrypt password + submit captcha → get session_token
3. POST /api/validate_otp/       → RSA-encrypt OTP → get auth_token (JWT)
```

## Dev / Automated Testing
```
POST /api/dev/token/  { username, password (plain-text) }  → auth_token
```
(Returns 403 in production when DEBUG=False)

## User Roles
superadmin | stateadmin | devicemanufacture | dealer | owner | esimprovider | filment | sosadmin | teamleader | sosexecutive | schooladmin | parentuser

Stand-alone captcha verification. captcha is the integer answer to the math expression.

Stage-1 login. Requires RSA-OAEP encrypted password and a valid captcha.

**For dev / automated tests use POST /api/dev/token/ instead** — the collection pre-request script does this automatically.

On success returns `token` (session token) + `status: otpsent`.

Stage-2: submit RSA-OAEP encrypted OTP to complete login.
Returns final `token` (JWT) and `token2` (MQTT token).

**DEV-ONLY** (returns 403 when DEBUG=False).

Bypasses RSA encryption, captcha, and OTP. Ideal for automated tests.
The collection pre-request script calls this automatically.
